about: numbers the tangent plane's and the ellipse's tests use. tan of one degree is a hand value from the definition of the gnomonic projection: a point a degree along the equator from a centre on it lands tan(1 degree) away. the rest are picked: centres and offsets across the sky, small fields of a degree, and the bounds the small-angle shortcut is held inside. of the shapes that are no ellipse, 700000 arcseconds is past the far side of the sky, half a turn being 648000, and a position angle of 400 degrees is more than a turn from north
